term_and_condition:
Welcome to Aurora Domus! We appreciate your interest in our Affiliate Program. By participating, you agree to comply with the following terms and conditions. If you do not agree, you are not authorized to register as an Aurora Domus affiliate.

1. Approval or Rejection of Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject any Affiliate Program registration at our sole discretion. You have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your application.

2. Affiliate Links and Coupons

Affiliate links are generated automatically, but you can also create links for specific products or collections. The most recent link clicked by a customer determines the commission.

Affiliates may receive one coupon code with usage details provided on the Dashboard. Double commissions are not awarded for combined use of affiliate links and coupon codes.

Affiliates are encouraged to promote the merchant's website on various online and offline channels, including social media and print advertisements.

3. Commissions and Payment

You will earn a 20% commission on the sale price of each order, excluding shipping fees and taxes, for successful referrals. To receive payments, provide your payment details in the Settings section. Payment schedules are outlined on the Affiliate Guide page.

Payments are made only for completed transactions. Each referral order is subject to review under our fair use policy. Commission statuses are displayed in the Commission tab, and paid commissions are listed in the Payment tab. Transactions resulting in chargebacks or refunds are not eligible for payment.

4. Marketing Tools

Promotional media, such as banners and logos, are available for download or as HTML embed codes in the Marketing tool tab. These can be used to promote affiliate channels.

5. Network

If the Network tab is activated, you can invite others to become downline affiliates. You will earn a network commission based on the merchant's settings for orders referred by downline affiliates. Share your network link to invite others; those who sign up through your link will become your downline affiliates.

6. Cookie Policy

We use cookies to track customers who click on your link. If cookies are not enabled or are cleared, we cannot track the customer's activity and therefore cannot pay commissions. The cookie duration is specified on the Affiliate registration form. Commissions are credited for all orders made within the cookie duration, even if the customer does not click the affiliate link again.

7. Removal from the Affiliate Program

To be removed from the affiliate program, contact us at menspluginfo@gmail.com.

Contact and Support

We are delighted to have you as part of our Affiliate Program. If you have any questions, please email menspluginfo@gmail.com.

Thank you for joining and happy referring!
